get.description: Performs a health check to validate the availability and operational status of the  Eligibility Pre Service.

200.description: Service is healthy - If the API engine is working correctly and if the entry points are accessible, the API operating status response shows "OK".

500.description:
Service is unhealthy
- **Note:** If you receive a response other than 200 OK, the health check failed. Please submit a ticket with Optum.

oAuth.description: This API uses OAuth 2 with the client_credentials grant flow.

scopes.create_coveragediscovery: submit a new coverage discovery task
scopes.read_healthcheck: check the status of the system
